text_block_list.text: *sniff*... *sniff*... Pheeeww... *sob*.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huh, whose voice is that...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Papa, Mama... I miss you. And I was looking forward to it so much... *sniff*

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: (Taiki-san is crying...! W-What happened...? I should go talk to—)

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Heh... *sniff*.
...I'll move my body and cheer up, desu...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah, Taiki-san...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
............
...Maybe something painful happened to them...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah.
Taiki-san is always cheering me on,
so today it's my turn...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Something sweet should cheer her up...
This cake... I absolutely have to nail it...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Where's the heavy cream?!
D-Did I forget to buy it...?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah-wa-wa-wa-wa!? Smoke is coming out of the oven~~!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... It's totally ruined...
I can't give anyone a cake like that...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Still, I—

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
It's already twilight, yet... *sniff*.
...My sad feelings won't go away...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"U-Um... err.
...May I sit next to you?"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Doto... *sniff*. Of course.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: *sniff*...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
...I couldn't meet with Mommy and Daddy.
We had promised, but their work got in the way...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*... S-Sorry.
Let's talk about something else!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"...N-No, that's not it.
I, um... ugh, sob—"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Waaaaaaah!
I'm sooorrrryyyy!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Doto!? What happened!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*hic*, *sniff*. Taiki's going through so much...!
And I, I couldn't do... anything...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I, I really wanted to... do so much more... *hic*...!
For everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Oh…… Like that…… Doto.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
I'm... sad, but happy, yes.
When Doto is by my side, I feel all warm inside.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: *sniffle*... *hic*... But, but...

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
My dear.
Please close your eyes.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Ah... Did you... wipe my tears away...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: We're both crybabies, so I think wiping our tears together is the best way.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Taiki-san...
*sniff*... You're right...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Then it's my turn this time...!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Doto... Thanks♪

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Trainer.

Just as I stepped out the front gate, I ran into Meisho Doto and the others.
...Her eyes were red. Had she been crying?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-No, not really...!
If anything, it's kind of the opposite of a fight...?

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
"Yes! The opposite of fighting!
In other words, it means this, right?♪"

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hup! First one to let go loses, yes!
Hehe, let's head home!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes! ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Tears of joy... Th-that sounds nice.

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Yes♪
A lot of happy things happened, after all.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes, there were...! So many... so very many...!

"Looking back on today, the two of them break into smiles.
They must have made wonderful memories together."
